content: {"praised":["More interesting adult storyline than the first film.","New character Time adds intrigue.","Johnny Depp’s Mad Hatter is sweet, funny, unique.","Alice helps Hatter find family, adds depth.","Visuals and adventure feel fresh and magical."],"criticized":["Sappy, terrible production, script seems brain dead.","Not directed by Tim Burton, feels like Disney yuck.","Loud musical score washes out voices, annoying.","Lousy story, non-existing plot, poor decisions.","Acting lacks depth, some performances weak."]}
